label: Period Signature
description: The room, street or machine that tells you the year without anyone having to say it.

items.name: jazz-interior
items.text: a room of lacquered surfaces and stepped geometry, cigarette smoke layered flat in the lamplight, a gramophone horn in the corner

items.name: motor-and-marquee
items.text: a tall narrow motor car at the kerb and a tiled theatre entrance behind, painted signwriting straight onto glass

items.name: blackout-street
items.text: a street under blackout, headlamps masked to slits, tape crossing every window and sandbags stacked against a doorway

items.name: hangar-line
items.text: a hangar apron with aircraft parked wing to wing, oil drums and chocks, painted instructions stencilled onto everything

items.name: chrome-diner
items.text: chrome and vinyl under fluorescent tube light, a formica counter, tail-finned cars nosed in at the window

items.name: new-suburb
items.text: a new suburban street of identical roofs and thin young trees, a station wagon on fresh concrete, television aerials repeating down the line

items.name: wood-panelled-room
items.text: wood-panelled walls, a shag rug and burnt-orange upholstery, a lamp with a shade the colour of weak tea

items.name: service-station
items.text: a service station under a wide flat canopy, plastic-lettered price signs and a car with a vinyl roof at the pump

items.name: neon-arcade
items.text: an arcade lit only by cabinet screens and neon tubing, carpet patterned to hide everything, a fog of cigarette and ozone

items.name: glass-office
items.text: a glass-and-brass office lobby with a potted ficus, a beige computer terminal glowing on a desk that is mostly telephone

items.name: reclaimed-street
items.text: a street the plants have taken back, buckled tarmac split by grass, a bus on its rims being used as a wall

items.name: scrap-settlement
items.text: a settlement built from what stood before it — corrugated sheet lashed to concrete, water drums under every downpipe, smoke from a stove going straight up
